# Terrain and Hydrological Context {#sec-terrain}

::: {.chapter-goal}
#### In this chapter
You will source global elevation data, derive slope and aspect, and use micro topography to separate intertidal wetland from upland forest before a classifier ever sees the pixels.
:::
